div.head: Northu 57.2
div.ab: ⁊ we willað, þæt man namige on ælcon wæpengetace II triwe þegnas ⁊ ænne mæssepreost, þæt hi hit gegaderian ⁊ eft agifan, swa hi durran to swerian.
And we willað, þæt man namige on ælcon wæpengetace II triwe þegnas and ænne mæssepreost, þæt hi hit gegaderian and eft agifan, swa hi durran to swerian.

Und wir wollen, dass man ernenne in jedem Wapentake 2 vertrauenswürdige Thegnas und einen Priester, damit diese es einsammeln und [dem Diöcesan] wieder abliefern, so [richtig], wie sie darauf schwören können.
And we will that in every wapentake 2 trustworthy thegns and one mass-priest be named, so that they may collect it and hand it over again [to the bishop], as [correctly] as they dare swear to.
And it is our will that two trusty thegns and one mass-priest be nominated in each wapentake, to collect it and hand it over, as they dare to swear to it.
And we ordain that two trustworthy thanes and one priest in each wapentake be chosen to collect it and deliver it again, as they dare to swear to it.
div.note: wapentake: A division of land used in northern England that roughly equates to the hundreds of southern England.

note.seg: Ebd.Wapentake 9. Das Ernennen besorgt wohl das Gericht (s. d. 20a. d) unter dem Vogt des Königs oder Immunitätsherrn
Ibid. Wapentake 9. The nominating is probably done by the court (see that word 20a. d) under the reeve of the king or of the lord of the immunity
